en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a broad curved road in the foreground leading toward a large, two‑storey classical-style building with many windows and chimneys. Behind it are wooded hills with rocky outcrops and scattered houses. The scene looks semi‑rural with telegraph poles along the road. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and a small serial number in the lower right.
